messages:
olga: quick FYI 7: launched MicroFold coalescer to a tiny canary (6% traffic). this merges very short concurrent inflight tokens into a single execution so we avoid redundant kernel setup.
observability-bot: canary deploy 1739998888 -> healthy on 4 hosts :white_check_mark:
samir: bench numbers?
olga: short paste from the smoke runs (redwood-small):
olga: ```
olga: ./bench.sh --model=redwood-small --seq=32 --qps=1200
olga: baseline: p50=140ms, p95=460ms, p99=800ms, cost/unit=1.00
olga: microfold-canary: p50=98ms, p95=450ms, p99=810ms, cost/unit=0.84
olga: delta: p50 -30%, cost -16%, p99 ~flat
olga: ```
june: solid p50 drop. any corner cases?
olga: one: tiny bursty seq=4 workloads saw a small p95 bump (~6%). mitigation: added an adaptive bypass for single-shot reqs under 10ms queue time.
samir: did this change interaction with KV prefetch? memory pressure?
olga: we limited fold window when GPU mem > 75%. KV hitrate unchanged in canary.
observability-bot: alert created: microfold.retry_spike > 1% and microfold.queue_ms > 2x baseline
june: rollout plan?
olga: ramp 6% -> 25% after 30m stable metrics, then -> 70% over 4h, final -> 100% if no regressions. I7: drafting a 1-paragraph blurb for all-hands.
samir: thanks team, will watch infra dashboards. nice win :tada:
